differences.what: the stable's place along the yard: through the house's camera the whole stable renders about 145-165 px right of where the photograph shows it (the lantern at x 1755-1845 against the print's 1610-1700, the wall gable at 1865-1945 against 1720-1793, and the storey-and-a-half wing's gable, which the print shows at x 1867-1945, beyond the frame at x 2035+): about 4 m along the wall at this distance. The stable stands where the 1911 sheet draws it; no camera fits the house's corners and the wing's corner both (the solve's search), and the house's own record has the fit and the sheet disagreeing by up to 2.5 m on its bay, so the gap is the sheet's against this camera, unresolved

the storey-and-a-half wing's gable to the yard: the print's gable reads about 2.4-3.3 m across under a pitch of about 26 degrees, where the sheet's crossed stable is 6.1 m from north to south and the build stands its gable on that whole end (the lunette, oculus and low band are built as the print shows them)
massing: a hipped slate roof on a bracketed cornice about 4.5 m up (the print's eave at y 915-935, the render's at y 920), the roof rising to about 6.3 m

the square lantern on the roof's north part: about 2 m across, three round-headed lights a face, its cornice at about 8.6 m (print y 790, render 795) under a pyramidal cap and a finial (print 757, render 745)

the wall gable on the yard front: a curved head rising about 0.95 m over the cornice, a small oculus in its face, over a two-light window in a pale stone frame under a hood (print y 937-1017, render 935-1000)
the round oculi about 1 m up the yard wall (three on the main block, one in the wing under its lunette)
the two short capped stacks on the roof's south part (built at the ridge; the print gives their x, not their depth)
the ivy and the trees before the stable's north part, and the people before its window
the colours: the print is monochrome (brick per the sheet, slate)
the stable's north end, its east face to the tracks and the wing's south face

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
